notes.title: Kodots Games Complete Bundle is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6948852/2ed05e06da776939c323bf224736091479dd6133.png[/img]

You can now purchase the complete set of our products to receive a great discount! This bundle includes [i]DarkEnd[/i], a dynamic Dungeon Crawler RPG, and [i]Wanda - A Beautiful Apocalypse[/i], a heartwarming story-driven adventure puzzle, along with a digital comic DLC.

[h1]DarkEnd [/h1]:griselda::xia::lucion::svas:
The all-devouring dimension called DarkEnd is spreading across the world! The fate of the world now rests in the hands of dauntless adventurers who brave into the ever-changing dungeons of DarkEnd to end the evil once and for all. Prepare to enjoy complex intertwining stories, unique skill learning system and challenging battles in this 2D dungeon crawler RPG. 

[h1]Wanda - A Beautiful Apocalypse [/h1]:bigbot::lilbot::petbottle:
Wanda is a story-driven puzzle adventure, about two lonely robots searching for happiness, hope and companionship in a post-apocalyptic world. The game features no readable dialogue but instead, the entire story is told in a subtle "show; don't tell" narrative. Join them on this unforgettable journey through a ruined world from a unique perspective, accompanied by children’s storybook art-style and atmospheric soundtrack. [Includes a digital comic DLC]

[h1]Buy it here![/h1] 
http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3567

Enjoy!

notes.title: DarkEnd version 1.5 released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/33637442/update.jpg[/img]

DarkEnd ver 1.5 is released with new features and bug fixes.

[h1] Changelog [/h1]
[list][*]Added 26 Steam Achievements! (Have fun hunting them!)
[*]Added "Milestone Leveling System". Your characters will automatically level up as the story advances. A great feature for those who do not wish to grind for EXP.
[*]Bugs from Fredrick Quest Hub are now fixed.
[*]Stats for some enemies have been rebalanced
[*]Added new musics!
[*]A new battle AI for the hardest hidden boss.
[*]Fixed minor mapping errors from several maps.
[*]Added a tutorial board for reviewing several tutorials.[/list]

[h1] Milestone Leveling [/h1]

DarkEnd is a traditional 2D RPG with dungeon-crawler and rogue-like elements. The game is heavily inspired by classic dungeon crawlers from the 90's and we made the game very hard and challenging to reflect that. However,we ended up alienating a lot of players who are new to dungeon-crawler RPGs as a result.

In ver 1.5, we added this new feature called "Milestone Leveling". Players who found the grinding process tedious, which is standard for most Dungeon-Crawlers, can now play the game completely free of grinding!

The update is now live! Please enjoy the game and happy hunting for new achievements!

-Kodots Games

notes.title: A FREE expansion and Update in progress!
notes.notes:
It has been 2 months since our release, so we decided to do a little update for DarkEnd – a FREE expansion! We gave consideration to suggestions given to us and hopefully, this expansion will make up for any contents we missed!

The expansion is titled ‘The Vault of Avalon,’ and will allow you to venture through a completely new land called Avirdel, which will give more insights to DarkEnd’s storyline, and of course, additional gameplay. 

This expansion will feature:

- A general graphical update
- An additional 5+ hours of gameplay
- More skills, new equipment and enemies
- A brand new side-story

This expansion will be accessible once the player reaches the end of the original game. We will be updating soon with our current progress, so do keep updated! Thanks for all your support!

Please check  [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/darkend] Indiedb [/url] for more details.

On a small note: DarkEnd has been featured as one of the 9 Best PC indie games of 2014 by Tech In Asia media. A big boost for a minuscule developers like us!

Check [url=https://www.techinasia.com/2014-best-indie-pc-games-asia/] Here [/url] for more details.
